name: Gold Cafe
kurzbeschreibung: Café, bakery and snack bar with Turkish specialities, homemade pastries and soups at Gewerbehof 1 in Kufstein.
beschreibung:
Gold Cafe is a café, snack bar and small bakery at Gewerbehof 1 in Kufstein. According to its own description, the team treats its guests to homemade pastries, soups and much more. The menu features Turkish specialities alongside snack-bar classics: in guest reviews, lentil soup, Gözleme with potato filling, Künefe as well as coffee and tea are particularly praised. Much of it is also available to take away.

The small establishment is located in the Zell district of Kufstein, not far from the town centre and Kufstein Fortress. It is open Monday to Saturday; Sunday is a day of rest.
